checkedAt.description:
CheckedAt is when the scheduler last checked (absent: never, so every
state is not-checked).

label.description: Label is what the OS calls it (Input Monitoring).

state.description:
State is what the scheduler last found: granted, missing, unknown (it
can't be checked), unsupported (not on this OS) or not-checked
(nothing recorded yet). Only missing and not-checked keep it from
running.

items.description: PermissionSource is what declares a permission something needs: a plugin it uses, its own program (a program's, a program hook's) or its watcher.

where.description:
Where says where it's turned on, following "turn it on" ("in System
Settings > Privacy & Security > Input Monitoring"), and SettingsURL is
the address that opens it (absent where there's none).

enabled.description:
Enabled is whether it's on: a routine or a hook enabled, a watcher not
paused.

items.description: PermissionSource is what declares a permission something needs: a plugin it uses, its own program (a program's, a program hook's) or its watcher.

by.description: By is what declares the permission for it.

items.description: PermissionUse is something that needs a permission: a routine (LLM), a program, a hook or a watcher.
PermissionStatus is a permission, what the scheduler last found, and everything that needs it (By: what declares it for any of them).

title: procauto permissions list --json
description: PermissionReport is what's needed, by what, and what the scheduler last found (`permissions list`).
